headerDisplay: Accepts the connection from the **RTI HomeKit Bridge (Inovattive)** driver running on the RTI processor. Accessories are configured in the driver, in Integration Designer. Running as a *child bridge* is recommended (child bridge button on the plugin card).

port.title: TCP port
port.description: The same port set in the RTI driver (default 51888).

allowedIp.title: RTI processor IPs (optional)
allowedIp.description: If set, only accepts connections from these IPs (comma separated; one driver instance per processor).

debug.title: Detailed log
debug.description: Logs every message exchanged with the RTI driver.
